source: Issue #553, 2026-10-14: the reporter's two diagnostics downloads of one account (a PowerOcean and a PowerPulse 2 linked to it), taken at different moments; union of their raw_frames, deduplicated by hex and ts_iso, ordered by time. Kept: every PowerOcean frame carrying 241/3 or 241/102 and the wallbox's own get_reply bundle carrying 241/44. Hex is byte-identical to the downloads except one user-chosen vehicle name, masked at equal length; serials were masked by the integration as 16 x 'X' and stay so. Each app write is labelled with the reporter's action log, times in UTC; six of the thirteen actions in his log have no write in either download.
